create_LauncherConfig_dataclass: create a LauncherConfig dataclass to define torchrun launcher settings for Hydra distributed training
configure_torchrun_nodes: configure min_nodes and max_nodes on LauncherConfig to control the number of training nodes
set_nproc_per_node: set nproc_per_node on LauncherConfig to specify how many processes to spawn per node
configure_rdzv_endpoint: configure rdzv_endpoint and rdzv_backend on LauncherConfig to set up rendezvous for distributed training
register_torchrun_config: register LauncherConfig with ConfigStore under hydra/launcher group with name torchrun
